arrival.speaker: Keeper Lan
arrival.say: Welcome to Tidewater Bay. The Great Forgetter has stopped our Clock Tower, and the sea can no longer remember when to rise or fall.

arrival.speaker: Keeper Lan
arrival.say: A young whale is stranded in the shallows. Restore the harbour words, help the rescue crew, and set time moving again.

reform.speaker: Idle Clock
reform.say: I let every useful moment drift away. If time never moves, no one can finish what they begin.

reform.speaker: Keeper Lan
reform.say: Rest is precious, but a life without purpose is only a stopped clock.

reform.speaker: Spirit Brush
reform.say: Current Stroke restored. The hidden Tide Vault can now be opened.
